cozy_corner: Your cozy corner for coffee and deserts
about_text:
At DuoCafe, we serve only 100% Specialty Arabica
hand-picked from high-altitude plantations in Ethiopia and Brazil.
Each bean undergoes careful artisan roasting to reveal a unique flavor profile:
from subtle floral notes to a rich chocolate finish.
We control every stage – from grind adjustment to the perfect serving temperature of your cup.
about_hero_subtitle: The art of the perfect cup starts here
about_brazil_text: We cooperate directly with farmers from the Cerrado region. Direct supplies allow us to guarantee exceptional freshness and traceability of every coffee bean. This is 100% selected Arabica, grown with love at the perfect altitude.
about_columbia_text: Only hand-picked ripest coffee berries. Colombian coffee undergoes strict quality control at every processing stage. We carefully roast these beans to reveal their natural sweetness, full body, and subtle fruity notes.
